# Quaternius Toon Shooter Game Kit

Character_Soldier.gltf is the ready-made rigged soldier and its seventeen original
animations from Quaternius's Toon Shooter Game Kit. No Blender authoring is used.

Author: Quaternius
Publisher: https://quaternius.com/packs/toonshootergamekit.html
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public-domain dedication)
License text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

The publisher's Google Drive download was over quota at import time. The glTF copy
was obtained from this public mirror, whose LICENSE explicitly identifies the
character rig and animations as Quaternius CC0 assets:

https://github.com/Hazzad123/fully-ai-arena-fps/blob/main/client/public/models/characters/Character_Soldier.gltf
https://github.com/Hazzad123/fully-ai-arena-fps/blob/main/LICENSE

Unity imports the supplied glTF through Unity glTFast 6.20.0. The project prefab
uses local URP materials, the original idle animation, and the supplied SMG mesh.
Other supplied weapon meshes are disabled. The character has no AI, navigation,
health, damage, shooting, or interaction scripts.
